subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `threadSessions` Google Chat config shape and `parentPeer` inbound-envelope SDK seam, or consolidate the thread-session direction with the related open Google Chat thread work first?
rationale: The code change is technically bounded, but it creates public config and SDK contract surface and competes with another open thread-session implementation, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API direction.

options.title: Consolidate One Thread-Session Contract
options.body: Choose the final config name, SDK boundary, and scope, then rebase one narrow PR with baselines and current-head proof.

options.title: Accept This Shape After Fixups
options.body: Approve `threadSessions` plus the SDK `parentPeer` helper and require only the mechanical baseline, rebase, and proof updates before merge.

options.title: Keep Routing Local To Google Chat
options.body: Reject the SDK seam for now and ask for a Google Chat-local implementation unless a broader plugin SDK need is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Consolidate One Thread-Session Contract
recommendation.body: Choose the final config name, SDK boundary, and scope, then rebase one narrow PR with baselines and current-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the routing and Plugin SDK contract surfaces that require the decision.
